title: Upload passport for “student verification”
scenario: A site offering student discounts asks you to upload your passport and a selfie because your university email “could not be verified automatically.” The offer is attractive but the service is unfamiliar.

answers.A: Ask whether a less sensitive proof of enrollment can be used instead.
answers.B: Upload the documents if the discount is valuable and the site uses HTTPS.
answers.C: Use a recognized student-verification provider or verify the offer with the merchant before uploading identity documents.

explanation: HTTPS protects the connection, not the legitimacy of the recipient. Identity data should be proportional to the benefit and provider trust.
proTip: A discount should not require an identity package from a stranger.
